department: Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics

deadline.value: Biochemistry takes applications for the following fall by December 15.
deadline.quote: An application must be completed and submitted before December 15 for enrollment in the following fall semester.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional; the group prefers 80th percentile or higher.

ielts_min.value: Biochemistry requires IELTS 6.5 overall, with at least 7 in speaking.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum score of 6.5 on the IELTS is required

also.quote: A minimum score of 7 in the speak portion of the IELTS is required

supervisor.value: Students choose a research advisor from 22 faculty after admission.
supervisor.quote: They may select their research advisors from among 22 faculty members in our interdepartmental BMB Graduate Group

funding.value: The group admits only applicants it can fund with a teaching or research assistantship and tuition waiver.
funding.quote: The Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics Graduate Group admits only those applicants for whom financial support is available.

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's is expected; a three-year bachelor's followed by a master's is also accepted.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a four-year Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution (a three-year Bachelor's degree followed by a Master's degree is also acceptable)

gre_subject.value: The GRE Subject test is not mentioned on the pages fetched.

notes: Pathobiology and physiology PhDs in the College of Veterinary Medicine are on the official list but not researched here.
